note: A self-hosted ntfy with auth enabled (auth-default-access: deny-all) and no token in ntfyUrl.
source: synthesized: ntfy's errHTTPUnauthorized JSON body (code 40101), shaped like the captured 400/404 bodies
gap: 401 is retried forever on the outage backoff (1 s doubling to 5 min) at warn level, with only `HTTP 401` as the error and no hint to add a token (`?auth=`).
